title: SA/145/2007 of DIRGHPAL SINGH Vs STATE

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Second Appeal No. 145 of 2007
Dirghpal Singh S/o Late Sri Mor Singh
R/o Dubatta Barkot
Distric Uttarkashi.

Versus
State of Uttarakhand through Collector Uttarkashi.
............. Respondent
Mr. B.P.S. Mer, Advocate, present for the appellant.
Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate, present for the respondent/State.
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Heard.
2) This second appeal was dismissed on 17.04.2008, on
the ground that neither the appellant removed the defects
pointed out by the Registry, nor the appeal was within time.

3) It appears that on 08.11.2010, Review Application
(MCC) No. 527 of 2010, alongwith Substitution Application
(CLMA) No. 5433 of 2010, and Delay Condonation
Applications No. 5431 of 2010 and 5432 of 2010, were moved.
All the above four applications were dismissed on 04.11.2011,
as no one turned up on behalf of the appellant to press said
applications.

2
4) Again, Recall Application (MCC) No. 238 of 2012,
was moved alongwith Delay Condonation Application No. 3010
of 2012, on 10.04.2012, for recall of order dated 04.11.2011.
5) On 06.08.2012, when these applications were taken
up, there was no one present on behalf of the appellant to press
the above two applications. However, the Court had been kind
enough to allow these two applications namely Recall
Application (MCC) No. 238 of 2012 and Delay Condonation
Application No. 3010 of 2012), but inadvertently, it was
mentioned that the appeal stood restored.
6) Actually, by allowing Delay Condonation
Application No. 3010 of 2012, for condonation of delay in filing
Recall Application (MCC) No. 238 of 2012, (which was also
allowed), the Review Application No. 527 of 2010, filed
alongwith Delay Condonation Applications No. 5431 of 2010
and 5432 of 2010, stood restored, as the same were dismissed
on 04.11.2011.
7) Today having heard learned counsel for the parties and
after perusal of the affidavits filed in support of Delay
Condonation Application (CLMA) No. 5431 of 2010 and Delay
Condonation Application (CLMA) 5432 of 2010, filed
alongwith Review Application (MCC) No. 527 of 2010 and
Substitution Application (CLMA) No. 4533 of 2010, this Court
is of the view that there is no sufficient explanation of long
delay (about two years) in moving Substitution Application and

3
Review/Recall Application No. 527 of 2010, as such the same
are hereby dismissed.
8) Assuming that the appeal was restored by this Court
vide its order 06.08.2012, even then, since the plaintiff/appellant
had died on 01.10.2010, and no substitution was made in the
appeal, within the period of limitation, nor any application for
setting aside abatement was moved till date, this appeal stands
abated.
9) Registry is directed to consign the record to the
record room.
 (Prafulla C. Pant,J.)
04.09.2013
JM
